I have all the evidence I need. Here is my report.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerdict","claim":"The inject-mode result contract requires the agent's final line to match /^\\s*VERDICT:\\s*(pass|fail|partial)\\s*(?:[—–-]+\\s*(.*))?$/i; a missing marker resolves to verdict 'fail' with null what_tried","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:52-59"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseFindings","claim":"The FINDINGS line is optional and strictly additive — malformed JSON, non-array, or non-object items never fail the step; they return empty findings plus an error string the runner only logs","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:14-30"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#FINDINGS_MAX","claim":"At most 20 findings are kept per output (FINDINGS_MAX=20), and the parser scans lines from the bottom up, taking the last FINDINGS line found","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:13,16,25,27"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerify","claim":"VERIFY is an optional first-line convention in step.context parsed via /^VERIFY:\\s*(.+)$/m, left verbatim in context and never stripped","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:61-71"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#runVerify","claim":"runVerify runs the VERIFY command with shell:true (deliberate, trusted step-author input) and a 10-minute default timeout, returning ok/code/tail where tail is the last 500 chars of combined stdout+stderr","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:77-81"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs#applyVerifyGate","claim":"The VERIFY gate only downgrades a claimed 'pass' to 'fail' when the command exits non-zero; it is a no-op when there is no VERIFY command or the claimed verdict was not 'pass'","evidence":"scripts/runner-lib.mjs:88-97"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#workPlan","claim":"In inject mode the runner parses the verdict, applies the VERIFY gate, records the attempt with executor 'runner-inject', and absorbs findings only when the run did not error (res.isError false)","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:327-351"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#workPlan","claim":"In MCP mode the VERIFY gate re-checks after the agent exits: if the step status is 'done' but VERIFY fails, the runner records an overriding fail attempt with executor 'runner-mcp'","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:373-386"}]

VERDICT: pass — verified how runner-lib.mjs defines and enforces the inject-mode VERDICT/FINDINGS output contract and the VERIFY gate, and how runner.mjs applies them in both inject and MCP modes.
